title: pm-dispatch: point same-file queueing at area-lease.md's overlap check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94ScD5RMFUJoZsYf2GZvDnw)_

Fixes #34527

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 里仍写「同文件默认串行 / 拿不准就串行 / 相交即串行」的 15 处改成指针，指向 `area-lease.md` 的重叠检查(含 `area:*` 同轴在飞与 `Notify: serial` 的触发);座位贴的「热文件串行队」段名不变，定义改成「重叠检查排后的卡 + 车道章程点名的串行链」。
- 为什么改:#34512 已把规则换成 merge-tree 重叠检查，但别处还留着旧的默认串行，席位读到哪处就按哪处做，同一情形会有两种答案。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `.claude/**` 文本，不动脚本、门禁与上限;语义耦合类(同引擎 seam、版本族、生成物、合并队列)的串行规则原样保留。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`references/execution-duties.md` 第 26、32–35 行(fold-or-serial 与并行纪律),`references/seat-post-protocol.md` 第 19–20 行,`SKILL.md` 第 128 行(`area:*`)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -nE '串行|热文件|同文件' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch`,剩余命中都在下表「不改」一栏且各有理由。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(Tier S,达档 L2 PASS 后由区落地)。

## What changes

PR #34512 moved same-file queueing to one rule: the overlap check in `references/area-lease.md` (claim time and before every push; only exit 1 queues behind the listed PR). Several pm-dispatch passages still stated the old same-file serial default. Each is now a pointer to that rule's single home; `area-lease.md` itself is untouched and its exit-code table is not restated anywhere.

Two classes are kept apart:

- **Textual same-file** (two cards editing one file): the old default becomes a pointer to the overlap check.
- **Semantic coupling** (one engine seam, a version family, generated artifacts, the merge queue as a serial resource): merge-tree cannot see it, so those rules stay as they are.

The seat post's `热文件串行队` section keeps its name (existing seat posts carry it; the L2 record chose to keep it). Its definition now admits two kinds of entry: the cards the overlap check queues behind a PR, and the serial chains a lane charter still names (the version-family chain in `lanes/server.md`, the generated-artifact relay), so those chains keep their place on the post and in the handover. Region-level declaration is unchanged (`execution-duties.md` 35). The fold-or-serial five-gate fold judgment is kept; only the non-fold branch changes, and its answer lives in the chain-head claim. The overlap check's exit-code arm is not restated outside `area-lease.md`.

### Every done-when grep hit (`git grep -nE '串行|serial|热文件|同文件|hot file'` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`, `area-lease.md` excluded as the rule's home)

Changed (line numbers at `origin/main` 107d2e84):

| File:line | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md:128` (`area:*` row; review round) | 同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交 | 同轴可多卡在飞,排队照重叠检查 (paid inside the row: 338 B → 332 B, pin 341) |
| `SKILL.md:127` (p0 row) | 不豁免同文件串行与认领协议 | 不豁免重叠检查(`references/area-lease.md`)与认领协议 |
| `SKILL.md:162` | 只决定文件归属:锚定、热文件串行、单认领路径 | 只决定文件归属:锚定、单认领路径 (a domain no longer decides same-file queueing) |
| `SKILL.md:184` | 相交 ⇒ 排该 PR 之后串行或让行 | 相交 ⇒ 照重叠检查排队或让行 |
| `SKILL.md:327` (claim template) | 点名同文件/同包的前驱 PR 与在飞认领 | 点名同包的前驱 PR 与在飞认领(同文件照 references/area-lease.md 重叠检查) |
| `execution-duties.md:24` | p0 无槽或低级在飞同文件挡住 | p0 无槽或低级在飞 PR 重叠挡住 |
| `execution-duties.md:26` | 同区域单跨轮硬串行 | 同区域单照重叠检查排队 |
| `execution-duties.md:32` | 显式答折叠或串行 | 显式答折叠与否 (five gates kept) |
| `execution-duties.md:33` | 答题处是串行队条目或链首认领,不答默认串行即漏答;串行后卡待前卡 MERGED 才开线程 | 答题处是链首认领(排后的卡另记串行队);不折叠则排队与否照 `area-lease.md` 重叠检查 |
| `execution-duties.md:35` | 认领申报文件面到区域级,拿不准就串行 | 认领申报文件面到区域级,排队与否照重叠检查 |
| `execution-duties.md:45` | 在飞求交加读 `domain:ui` 的 `pm:dispatched` 认领文件面;相交 ⇒ 串行或让行 | 在飞求交加读 `domain:ui` 认领文件面;相交 ⇒ 照重叠检查排队或让行 (`pm:dispatched` cut: SKILL.md:182 defines 在飞检查 as reading `pm:dispatched` claims, which survives) |
| `seat-post-protocol.md:19` | 热文件串行队是跨轮跨班次的常设事实:文件 → 有序卡片清单 → 每张卡认领的区域 | 热文件串行队收重叠检查(`area-lease.md`)排后的卡与车道章程点名的串行链,跨轮跨班次常设: / 文件或链 → 有序卡片清单 → 每张卡认领的区域 (two lines) |
| `seat-lifecycle.md:31` | 热文件串行队是正文具名段:区域写不清就只能整文件串行 | 热文件串行队是正文具名段:收 `area-lease.md` 重叠检查排后的卡与车道章程点名的串行链 |
| `project-forms.md:45` (review round) | 席→兄弟席或他车道:认领文件面相交或须先落 `Notify: serial` | 席→兄弟席或他车道:重叠检查令排后或须先落 `Notify: serial` |
| `lanes/objectstack.md:15` | `domain:*` 只定文件归属与串行 | `domain:*` 只定文件归属 (mirrors SKILL.md:162) |

Not changed, with the reason:

| File:line | Why it stays |
|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md:186` | The merge queue is a serial resource: semantic, not textual. |
| `lanes/server.md:56`, `:58` | Version-family upgrade and a shared engine/datasource seam: semantic coupling merge-tree cannot see. |
| `landing-operations.md:104` (and `:32`'s `Blocked-by`/serial-line form) | Generated-artifact serial relay: semantic; `:32` names a dependency line form, not a default. |
| `platform-readings.md:80` | Measured merge-queue throughput reading. |
| `lanes/objectstack.md:28` | Already states the merge-tree answer (queue only on a real overlap); consistent, one answer. |
| `seat-post-protocol.md:16`, `:17`, `:52` (`:53` after this diff); `seat-lifecycle.md:22`; `execution-duties.md:48` | Name the `热文件串行队` section only; its meaning is redefined at `seat-post-protocol.md:19` and `seat-lifecycle.md:31`, and the handover at `:53` carries both kinds of entry. Section name kept (see Acceptance notes). |
| `execution-duties.md:32` (`fold-or-serial` label, 热文件 trigger), `:86`; `lanes/skills.md:35`; `dispatch-runbook.md:33` | The fold question and the claim's serial-constraints field: the fold judgment is kept, and the field is a reading slot, not a default. |
| `dispatch-runbook.md:90`; `triage-duties.md:77`, `:79`, `:98` | Unrelated senses (a control word in the same file; same-file same-mechanism dedupe; a count of serial cards as a maintenance signal). |

## Tests

Text-only change under `.claude/**`; no behaviour is pinned, so no ablation. Line ratchet (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`) green on every touched file: SKILL.md 329/329 and widest table row 341/341 (untouched row 118; the p0 row is 264 B, the `area:*` row 332 B); execution-duties 190/190; seat-lifecycle 100/100; seat-post-protocol 88/88 (+1, inside the ceiling's existing headroom); project-forms 59/59; lanes/objectstack 35/35. Every added prose line is at most 120 bytes. No ceiling or pin moved; no line was bought by a re-wrap.

## Acceptance notes

- Section name `热文件串行队` and the `fold-or-serial` label kept, as the L2 record decided: a rename changes no behaviour and makes every live seat post stale.
- Follow-up, outside this card's surface: the English `when` text of `notify:serial` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` still reads "claimed file surfaces overlap, or one card must land first"; it should follow `project-forms.md` 45.
- Accepted deviation (review nit): for a p0, `execution-duties.md` 24 pauses the lower-grade dev rather than queueing the p0 behind its PR, while `SKILL.md` 127 says the p0 is not exempt from the check; the pair predates this PR, and the cross-reference belongs in the rule's home, a follow-up card.
- Accepted deviation (review nit): `execution-duties.md` 23 ("同批独立按文件面不相交判") is about the lock-width cap, not queueing; left as is.
- `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before the first push: `VERDICT clean exit 0` on b28bd177 (origin/main 107d2e84), bef42322 (after merging origin/main 7b3e9558) and bafc4d82 (origin/main 1e4656d0) — 0 PR heads sharing a file each time.
